web_login.title: Log in to the {model}
web_login.description: The {model} has no network server login that Home Assistant can use. The gateway itself is shown: online state, firmware and system values. Its devices appear when it publishes their uplinks by MQTT: give each application on the gateway an MQTT topic with $deveui in it, and enter the same topic here with {dev_eui} in its place.

data_description.username: The username to log in to the Milesight gateway.
data_description.password: The password to log in to the Milesight gateway.
data_description.mqtt_topic: For example sensors/lora/uplink/{dev_eui}. {dev_eui} marks where the devEUI sits; any other placeholder in curly braces, or +, matches anything. Leave empty to show the gateway only.

downlink_failed.message: The gateway did not accept the command for the device: {error}

data.network_panel: Show the network map in the sidebar

data_description.scan_interval: How often the gateway is read: its device list, or for a gateway without one, whether it answers.
data_description.status_interval: How often to read the gateway's status: links, packets, CPU and memory.
data_description.web_data: Serial number, CPU load, memory, storage and uptime, read from the gateway's web interface with the same account.
data_description.firmware_check: Look up the newest gateway firmware on milesight.com twice a day.
data_description.devices: Only these devices get entities. Leave empty for all devices. Devices you remove from the list are removed from Home Assistant with their entities.
data_description.data_source: Where the devices' sensor values come from.
data_description.all_settings: LoRaWAN only. Every device always gets report interval, target temperature (thermostats), reboot and status request. Switched on, each device also gets an entity for every other setting its codec knows, about 25: alarms, thresholds, calibration. They start disabled; enable the ones you need.
data_description.mqtt_topic: For example sensors/lora/uplink/{dev_eui}. {dev_eui} marks where the devEUI sits; any other placeholder in curly braces, or +, matches anything. Leave empty to show the gateway only.
data_description.network_panel: LoRaWAN only. One menu entry serves all gateways; switched off at any of them, it leaves the sidebar. The page keeps its address and the dashboard card still works.

confirm_source.title: Switch from {old} to {new}?
confirm_source.description: Values both sources report keep their entities, entity IDs and history. Entities only {old} provides are removed; the settings and buttons of the devices differ between the two sources. Values only {new} provides appear as the devices report. The integration reloads.

error.invalid_topic: The topic needs whole levels: {dev_eui} at most once, + or another placeholder only as a full level, no #.

options.lorawan: LoRaWAN: reads the gateway's packet log and decodes with Milesight's own codecs. Needs no MQTT broker. Settings go to the devices through the gateway's network server, for every model Milesight publishes a codec for.
options.mqtt: MQTT: takes what the gateway publishes, decoded by the payload codecs set up on the gateway. Needs an MQTT broker in Home Assistant. Settings go to the devices through the gateway's network server, for the models this integration describes itself.
